title: THE EMPTY RETICLE NAMES THE RELOAD KEY
why: Found by the whole-game bug hunt of 2026-10-08. When the magazine runs dry the crosshair turns amber and reads EMPTY - R, so the eyes never have to leave it (his v2.99 note). On a controller there is no R: reload is X. A keyboard player who moved reload in CHANGE KEYS was also told R. It now reads like a shooter HUD and names the reload button of the device in hand, as every other prompt does: [X] RELOAD on a pad, [SQUARE] RELOAD on a PlayStation pad, [R] RELOAD on a keyboard (the raid text plan, R22). NO AMMO and JAMMED keep their words.
now: The empty crosshair now says [X] RELOAD on a controller and [R] RELOAD on a keyboard, the reload button you have.
